system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we structure screening with five components: study objectives, inclusion/exclusion criteria, chain-of-thought reasoning instructions, article abstract and structured output format.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; prompt structure with per-article variables inferred as templated.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Converted articles undergo full-text screening using the tested model with a prompt structure analogous to abstract screening
env_context_strategy.note: Article text supplied in prompt; closest value; no retrieval/navigation described. Paper-only.

context_compaction.note: No code/config available; paper does not discuss history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The process produces one Markdown file per article.
observation_format.note: Articles given as OCR markdown text; tool outputs not described.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: with tool calls and requests schematised through OpenAI’s Responses and Chat Completions APIs.

tool_count.note: Paper mentions parameter-, model-, outbreak-specific tool calls but no exact tool count; appendix I truncated.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Extraction assumes the use of agentic models and provides tools that enforce schematised and structured outputs
edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing harness; tools are extraction forms.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: we defined acceptable values based on the PERG REDCap survey schema

protocol_standardization.note: No code available to grep for MCP/A2A.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the pipeline first conductspresence flaggingto identify articles containing relevant data, followed by targeted extraction
loop_primitives.note: Staged workflow: search, screening, OCR, full-text screening, extraction, report.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The first is a workflow built to replicate the main evidence-handling stages of a human-conducted epidemiological SLR

human_in_loop.note: Human abstract conditioning is an evaluation ablation; annotation tool (App. M) truncated.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The download pipeline incorporates caching, streaming and file validation, parallel execution and checkpointing.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Extracted data are converted into a report using LLM self-refinement

termination_condition.evidence_quote: with a maximum generation limit of 64K tokens per pass.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The download pipeline incorporates caching, streaming and file validation

guardrails.evidence_quote: Because of schema verification applied in the tool-calling stage, LLMs produce no such invalid extractions.
